capabilities.headline: A platform your shop can run, with an engineer in the building.
capabilities.lede: Auxo is how the agency runs the desk, not a chatbot bolted onto email. We wire it to your stack, your playbooks, and your license boundaries. You book a call. We sit with ops. The first lane goes live in three weeks.

cards.title: One schema across every AMS
cards.body: Auxo normalizes AMS360, HawkSoft, Epic, and the rest into one consistent shape for clients, policies, coverages, and expirations, then writes back through documented APIs.

cards.title: Forward deployed, not dropped in
cards.body: An Auxosure engineer sits with your team, and the first service is live in three weeks: Strategize, Build, Run.

cards.title: Same services, each book's rules
cards.body: Renewals, certificates, and intake run the same way every time. Limits, carrier order, and approvals are encoded per book. If a desk runs more than one AMS, the books stay separate.

cards.title: Humans keep the exceptions
cards.body: Licensed CSRs and producers see what Auxo did, approve the gaps, and take the calls that need a license.

work.lede: See Auxo on first notice, certificates, and intake to quote. Start with the lane that hurts. The rest of the nine-module engine sits underneath.

services.headline: End-to-end agency automation
services.description: Four pillars that cover the desk, the producer, service, and the book. Start with the one that hurts. Add the rest on the same rails.
services.footerLine: Pick the first service. Licensed people keep the exceptions.

pillars.label: Front office
pillars.title: Handle every request without adding to the queue.
pillars.body: Inbound demand answered, qualified, and routed before it piles up on the desk.

modules.name: Inbound Calls
modules.line: Answer new business and existing customer calls, capture the reason for the call, and route it to the right person.

modules.name: Lead Intake
modules.line: Qualify new business, collect basic account information, and create the intake record for the producer.

modules.name: Document Requests
modules.line: Request ACORDs, loss runs, driver lists, applications, and other information needed to move the account forward.

modules.name: Appointments & Follow-Ups
modules.line: Schedule producer calls, confirm appointments, and follow up when customers don't respond.

pillars.label: Producer support
pillars.title: Keep producers selling instead of chasing information.
pillars.body: Submissions, gaps, quoting, and carrier chase stay on rails so producers stay in front of the client.

modules.name: Submission Intake
modules.line: Collect ACORDs, applications, loss runs, SOVs, and supporting documents for new business.

modules.name: Missing Information
modules.line: Identify what's missing from a submission and follow up with the client to complete the file.

modules.name: AI Quoting
modules.line: Run the submission through supported carrier portals, collect quotes and requirements, and bring the results back for review.

modules.name: Carrier & Underwriter Follow-Up
modules.line: Check submission status, follow up on outstanding questions, and keep producers informed.

pillars.label: Policy service
pillars.title: Take everyday service off your CSRs.
pillars.body: Endorsements, certificates, billing questions, and document filing handled without a growing backstack.

modules.name: Endorsements
modules.line: Capture policy change requests, collect supporting information, and route them for processing.

modules.name: Certificates & ID Cards
modules.line: Handle COI and ID card requests without making customers wait for a CSR.

modules.name: Billing & Policy Questions
modules.line: Answer routine billing and policy questions and route anything requiring licensed staff.

modules.name: Policy Documents
modules.line: Collect, organize, and attach policy documents, correspondence, and supporting files to the right account.

pillars.label: Book management
pillars.title: Stay ahead of the files that protect your book.
pillars.body: Renewals, claims, commissions, and open loops tracked before they fall through the cracks.

modules.name: Renewals
modules.line: Track upcoming renewals, collect updated information, and follow up on outstanding requirements.

modules.name: Claims
modules.line: Capture FNOL information, collect supporting documents, and provide customers with claim status updates.

modules.name: Commission Reconciliation
modules.line: Match carrier commission statements, identify discrepancies, and prepare exceptions for the accounting team.

modules.name: Customer Follow-Up
modules.line: Follow up on outstanding requests, documents, payments, and other items that could otherwise fall through the cracks.
